# Bitcoin Friesland

> Bitcoin Friesland (Frysk: Bitcoin Fryslân) is a volunteer community for Bitcoin education, adoption and meetups in the Dutch province of Friesland. Participation in the community and its Telegram and Signal groups is free. The site is informational and does not provide financial advice.

The site is available in Dutch (`nl`), English (`en`) and Frisian (`fy`). Dutch is the default language.

The linked HTML pages are the primary source; Markdown counterparts are summaries. For changing event details and business payment options, check the organizer or business linked from the relevant page. Community contributors maintain this website; corrections can be sent to info@bitcoinfriesland.com with the page URL and a supporting source. A listing is not an endorsement.

The map pages include a searchable business list by name, town or type. All listings remain readable without JavaScript; search only filters the existing list and does not verify a business's current payment options.

Important facts:

- Supporter programme: in preparation. Payments and organisation are not in place yet, so nothing can be paid or ordered. The support page has a waitlist and feedback form; people on the waitlist hear first when it starts. No start date has been announced.
- Planned supporter contribution: the current value of EUR 21 a year, paid in sats. Planned benefits: 21 Bitcoin Friesland stickers, event discount codes and a supporter tag in Telegram and Signal.
- Financial or material support never buys influence, exclusivity, editorial control or an endorsement.
- Bitcoin map, October 2026: 43 places in 20 Frisian towns accept Bitcoin or Lightning, 14 of them in Sneek. Listing on the map will become paid in the future; no date or price has been announced.
- Bitcoin Friesland was started by two Noderunners (https://noderunners.network/).
- Follow the community on Nostr (npub15qgfat6kkmzecup683u64lalqdceaejq97d8z8njhwk0c68umx6qcs5dcm) and on X (@bitcoinfryslan).

## Quick answers

**What is Bitcoin Friesland?** A volunteer community for Bitcoin education, adoption and meetups in the Dutch province of Friesland (Frysk: Fryslân). It is independent of sponsors, supporters and businesses.

**Is it free to join?** Yes. Joining the community and its Telegram and Signal groups is free. Supporting the community financially is optional and gives no influence over content.

**How do I get started with Bitcoin in Friesland?** Read the beginner guide, pick a wallet, buy a small amount and visit a meetup. Nothing on the site is financial advice.

**Where can I pay with Bitcoin in Friesland?** The Bitcoin map lists businesses and places in Friesland that accept Bitcoin or Lightning. Confirm with the business before you go.

**How can a business start accepting Bitcoin?** The business page explains a simple point-of-sale setup, custodial versus self-custodial options and bookkeeping basics. Bitcoin Friesland offers no paid consultancy.

**Are there upcoming meetups?** The meetings page lists upcoming and past events and is the primary source; the Telegram group announces new dates first.

**How often are there meetups?** Since 2025 there has been a meetup roughly every month or two, in towns such as Sneek, Leeuwarden, Harlingen, Drachten and Heerenveen, plus a yearly summer BBQ. Entry is free; food and drinks can usually be paid in sats.

**Is there a tool to convert sats to euros?** Yes. The sats calculator converts sats to euros or dollars and back with the live price: https://bitcoinfriesland.com/nl/sats-calculator

**How do I contact the community or report a mistake?** Email info@bitcoinfriesland.com with the page link and, if possible, a source.

## News and feeds

- [Dutch Bitcoin Friesland news](https://bitcoinfriesland.com/nl/blog/): Guides, news and community stories.
- [Dutch RSS feed](https://bitcoinfriesland.com/nl/blog/rss.xml): Machine-readable feed for new articles.
- [Getting started with Bitcoin in Friesland](https://bitcoinfriesland.com/nl/blog/beginnen-met-bitcoin-in-friesland): Practical Dutch beginner guide.
- [Storing bitcoin safely](https://bitcoinfriesland.com/nl/blog/bitcoin-veilig-bewaren): Dutch guide to recovery phrases, hardware wallets and avoiding scams.
- [Paying with Lightning](https://bitcoinfriesland.com/nl/blog/betalen-met-lightning): Dutch guide to Lightning wallets, paying by QR code and where to pay in Friesland.
- [Accepting Bitcoin as a business](https://bitcoinfriesland.com/nl/blog/bitcoin-accepteren-als-ondernemer): Dutch step-by-step guide for Frisian businesses: payment apps, till, bookkeeping.
